blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. on Friday led the oath-taking ceremony for 4,125 newly promoted and newly hired education personnel of the Department of Education Region II in Santiago City, Isabela. The promotions were part of the Expanded Career Progression (ECP) System, which provides career advancement opportunities for public school teachers and school heads. READ: Marcos on school shootings: Parents observe kids’ behavioral changes In Region II, the ECP initiative covers teaching positions, including Teachers I–VII, Master Teachers I–IV, and Principals I–IV, as well as 1,197 newly created non-teaching positions.
